messages:
Sam: quick thread to lock down micro-beta selection criteria + eval plan. want a lightweight rubric we can run in parallel with outreach.
Yara: +1. propose 3 buckets for selection: integration complexity (low/med/high), workload representativeness (chat/generation/embeddings), and compliance needs (standard/regulated). each bucket gets a score 0-3.
Liam: sounds good. what about weighting? I think prioritize representativeness (x2), then compliance (x1.5), then complexity (x1).
Rashida: agree. we should also include a "repeatability" factor: can we reliably reproduce customer traffic in staging? that's critical for regression detection.
Sam: new combined score formula: total = (2*rep + 1.5*comp + 1*complex) * repeatability_factor. keep repeatability binary 0.5/1 for synthetic or real traffic.
Yara: nice. can someone draft the spreadsheet and the filter logic? Liam?
Liam: I'll do it. quick sketch of the SQL we'll use to pull candidate accounts (by usage patterns):
```
SELECT account_id, avg_daily_tokens, predominant_api_call, region
FROM usage_metrics
WHERE avg_daily_tokens BETWEEN 1000 AND 500000
  AND predominant_api_call IN ('chat.completions','embeddings')
  AND last_active > now() - interval '30 days'
ORDER BY avg_daily_tokens DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
Rashida: add a column for security level: has_vpc, enterprise_contract true/false. that'll map to compliance bucket.
Sam: outreach copy should ask about: preferred telemetry level, willingness to sign NDA, and preferred rollout window. keep it 1-2 questions inline.
Yara: for telemetry phrasing we should A/B test two variants: "minimal (no logs)" vs "minimal (anonymized telemetry)". wording matters for opt-ins.
Liam: I'll bake A/B test into the cadence sheet. also include an explicit checkbox for "allow sampled prompt traces" with retention 30d.
Rashida: launch acceptance criteria suggestion: 1) at least 3 distinct customers with production traffic running for 48h without incidents, 2) no critical security findings, 3) evaluation harness detects <5% quality regressions vs baseline on DP-specific prompts.
Sam: add performance gate: P50 latency <= target and error rate < 1% over the 48h.
Yara: for the "quality regression" metric we need a defined eval set per DP. plan: ask each partner to provide 20-30 representative prompts; we run automated eval before/after.
Liam: implementable. I'll add a small script to upload eval sets to S3 and kick an eval job. snippet for eval job trigger payload: `{ "account": "<id>", "eval_id": "<uuid>", "baseline_model": "open-1.0", "candidate_model": "redwood-release-23" }`
Rashida: legal: we'll need a short DP addendum template that covers data residency, telemetry, and opt-out. @Legal can you look?
Legal: can do. send the outreach copy + telemetry options and I'll return a 1-page addendum. we prefer explicit retention durations in the copy.
Sam: operational notes: reserve 8 GPU slots per high-priority DP, 3 per medium. have a warm pool of 6 preloaded containers for fast provisioning. if capacity < 70% trigger fallback to hosted with notice.
ops-bot: Alert rule created: `microbeta-provisioning-cap` threshold 70%. Notifying #eng-oncall.
Yara: monitoring / instrumentation: capture token-level costs, P50/P95 latency, error codes, and a feedback event stream (user_id, prompt_hash, rating 1-5). keep feedback anonymized unless partner opts-in.
Liam: how do we capture "distinct regressions"? propose we detect statistically significant drops in evaluation score per prompt (p<0.05) and cluster them by failure mode.
Rashida: plus manual triage: require at least one human-verified regression before we count it. automated signals can surface candidates.
Sam: timeline: selection query runs Tue, outreach Wed-Fri, accept window 10 days, provisioning next Mon. weekly sync after provisioning for first 2 weeks.
Yara: retention signal target: keep at least 60% of DP sessions after 14 days. if below, trigger partner health check.
Liam: small ops automation: when a DP accepts, auto-create a repo issue in `dp-onboarding` with checklist items and assign to oncall. I can make a GitHub action for that.
Rashida: also include a data deletion endpoint in onboarding docs + a contact for security owner. Legal: confirm wording for deletion request handling.
Legal: will include deletion SLA (30 days max) in the addendum draft.
Sam: ok folks. action items: Liam -> spreadsheet + selection SQL + GH action; Yara -> outreach A/B copy + eval prompt request template; Rashida -> security checklist + onboarding docs; Legal -> DP addendum draft; Sam -> schedule weekly sync and finalize scoring weights.
Liam: I'll post the spreadsheet and GH action PR by EOD tomorrow.
Yara: outreach copy in the thread within 24h.
Rashida: security checklist draft by Thursday.
Legal: addendum on Friday.
Sam: thanks. keeping this thread as the authoritative record for selection & eval decisions. ping @here if anyone hits a blocker. :rocket:
